career_fact_conflicts_resolution_state_c.name: career_fact_conflicts_resolution_state_check
career_fact_conflicts_resolution_state_c.value: ("career_fact_conflicts"."status" = 'pending' and "career_fact_conflicts"."resolution" is null and "career_fact_conflicts"."resolved_at" is null and "career_fact_conflicts"."profile_version" is null) or ("career_fact_conflicts"."status" = 'resolved' and "career_fact_conflicts"."resolution" is not null and "career_fact_conflicts"."resolved_at" is not null and "career_fact_conflicts"."profile_version" is not null)

job_imports_url_provenance_check.name: job_imports_url_provenance_check
job_imports_url_provenance_check.value: ("job_imports"."input_type" = 'url') = ("job_imports"."requested_url" is not null and "job_imports"."final_url" is not null and "job_imports"."canonical_url" is not null and "job_imports"."page_classification" = 'job' and "job_imports"."source_kind" in ('official', 'aggregator'))

job_targets_active_secondary_slot_check.name: job_targets_active_secondary_slot_check
job_targets_active_secondary_slot_check.value: ("job_targets"."priority" = 'secondary' and "job_targets"."state" = 'active' and "job_targets"."active_slot" is not null and "job_targets"."active_slot" in (1, 2)) or (("job_targets"."priority" <> 'secondary' or "job_targets"."state" <> 'active') and "job_targets"."active_slot" is null)
